name: Jeanette Miller
bio: Jeanette Miller (July 30, 1932 – November 4, 2016) was an American character actress who appeared in theatre, film, and television series. She may be best known as Aunt Edie on the ABC comedy series The Middle, a role she played from 2009 until 2015. In film, she appeared in Cold Heaven, The Truman Show, Norbit, Four Christmases, and Legion.
